async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Select the Express template by clicking its 'Use template' radio button
    # Use filter to find the radio button associated with the Express template preview link
    # The accessibility tree shows multiple 'Preview' links and 'Use template' radio buttons
    # I'll filter the radio button that has a sibling or is near the Express preview link
    # Since the tree lists them sequentially, I can use nth to select the third radio button (index 2) as Express is the third template
    express_radio = page.get_by_role("radio", name="Use template").nth(2)
    await express_radio.click()
    # Wait for any UI updates or navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # After selecting the template, look for the project creation form
    # The form might appear dynamically, so wait a bit
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Fill in the project name as 'web_agent'
    # Look for a textbox with role 'textbox' and name related to project name
    project_name_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name", exact=False)
    await project_name_field.fill("web_agent")
    # Set the repository to private
    # Look for a radio button or checkbox for visibility, e.g., 'Private'
    private_option = page.get_by_role("radio", name="Private", exact=False)
    await private_option.click()
    # Click the 'Create project' button
    create_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project", exact=False)
    await create_button.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
